title: Strategic Customer Success Manager
description:
About Client

Our client is a leading AI-powered Analytics Platform as a Service (AnPaaS) that empowers product teams and developers to embed conversational, predictive, and agentic intelligence directly into applications and workflows. Our API-first, developer-first platform turns complex data into faster, smarter, actionable decisions for global customers across financial services, retail, healthcare, and technology.

With the recent launch of client Intelligence and Intelligence Assistant, we're accelerating innovation in embedded analytics, enabling governed, scalable AI experiences that bridge insights to real-time action.


The Role

As a Strategic Customer Success Manager, you will serve as a trusted advisor to mid-sized to large enterprise accounts, building deep relationships to maximize value, drive adoption of our AI-powered platform, and fuel retention and expansion.

You'll collaborate cross-functionally with Sales, Product, Engineering, and Support to ensure customers achieve their business goals through clear communication of complex concepts and proactive guidance.

Why Join Our Customer Success Team

This is a strategic, high-impact role where you'll own complex accounts, strengthen multi-threaded relationships, and deliver measurable outcomes (e.g., NRR, expansion revenue, AI feature adoption).

You'll work in a collaborative, innovative global environment, partnering with diverse teams to solve real customer challenges and contribute to product growth in embedded AI analytics.


About You

  • You thrive in fast-paced, evolving environments, adapting quickly while staying positive and solution-focused.
  • You're a natural relationship builder, skilled at nurturing trusted, multi-level partnerships and positioning yourself as a key advisor to drive customer success.
  • You quickly grasp business goals and technical concepts (including AI/analytics platforms) to align solutions with customer needs.
  • You're proactive and consultative, identifying opportunities, anticipating challenges, and advocating for customers while balancing business priorities.
  • You're collaborative, open to feedback, and passionate about delivering results through continuous learning and improvement.


Requirements

  • 3–5+ years as a Customer Success Manager (or equivalent), with proven success managing enterprise/mid-market accounts (SaaS/BI/analytics preferred).
  • Strong track record of driving product adoption, value realization, and revenue expansion.
  • Excellent presentation and executive communication skills; experience leading EBRs/QBRs and building C-level relationships.
  • Ability to own full account planning, health monitoring, and success strategy across a portfolio.
  • Proactive mindset: identify upsell/cross-sell opportunities, mitigate risks, and deliver measurable ROI.
  • Project management skills to handle complex implementations, onboarding, and technical discussions.
  • Experience collaborating cross-functionally (Sales, Product, Engineering) to resolve issues and influence roadmaps.
  • Exceptional interpersonal, listening, written, and verbal skills (fluent English required; Portuguese a plus).
  • Results-driven with strong critical thinking, problem-solving, and a customer-centric focus.
  • Comfortable in a dynamic, remote environment while managing multiple priorities.
  • Bonus: Background in Business Intelligence (BI), embedded analytics, AI/GenAI enablement, or similar technical solutions.

How You'll Ramp

By Day 30

  • Complete Customer Success onboarding and training (client values, culture, relationship techniques, product overview, competition, and transformational outcomes).
  • Begin meeting customers, shadowing QBRs/EBRs, and observing how we build relationships and deliver value.

By Day 60

  • Develop strategic account plans for your portfolio and start driving opportunities (adoption, expansion, renewals).
  • Deepen product and technical knowledge through coaching and hands-on work.
  • Fully embed with your accounts and collaborate side by side with the team.

By Day 90

  • Own your book of business end-to-end, driving partnership success and measurable results (NRR, adoption, expansion).
  • Master Customer Success best practices, including onboarding, proactive risk management, and AI feature enablement.
  • Become a key contributor to the team's revenue retention and growth goals.

Join Client!

Our client is pioneering the future of embedded analytics with AI at the core. This role offers more than a position — it’s an opportunity to shape customer outcomes in a transformative industry, work with a diverse, innovative global team, and grow in a collaborative culture that values impact and inclusivity.

If you're passionate about driving strategic customer success in AI-powered analytics, apply today. Let’s build the next era of intelligent decisions together.

title: Desenvolvedor Salesforce Service Cloud Sênior
description:
Código da vaga: 58531

Sobre a BRQ Digital

Há 33 anos no mercado, a BRQ Digital Solutions se consolidou como uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país. Com uma plataforma de serviços end to end, oferecemos as mais eficientes e inovadoras soluções, tecnologias e metodologias, promovendo uma jornada de transformação para grandes marcas, de diferentes segmentos, no Brasil e no exterior.

Temos 2.500 funcionários e a empresa é destaque como um dos melhores lugares para trabalhar pelo GPTW e Glassdoor.

BRQ WAY

No nosso BRQ WAY temos a missão de conectar, transformar e empoderar cada um dos nossos profissionais, que por aqui são chamados de feras, para que todos tenham a chance de usar sua paixão para transformar o mundo com tecnologia!

É isso que queremos, com nosso Programa de Diversidade e Inclusão trabalhamos com dois objetivos: equidade e inclusão, buscamos aumentar a participação dos grupos minoritários, quebrar os vieses inconscientes e expandir a conscientização sobre temas tão importantes para que todos sejam livres para serem quem são.

Vamos transformar juntos! Vem ser fera com a gente!

- O que procuramos?

Buscamos um #fera com espírito empreendedor e que sabe que é o verdadeiro protagonista do seu sucesso! Queremos em nosso time pessoas motivadas por desafios, constante evolução e, claro, que são apaixonadas por tecnologia e transformação!

- O que você deve ter?

Responsabilidades:

  • Implementar funcionalidades em Apex (triggers, services, batch/queueable/schedulable), garantindo bulkification, testes e respeito aos limites da plataforma.
  • Desenvolver Lightning Web Components (LWC) com arquitetura limpa, performance, consumo de dados via LDS/wire e chamadas @AuraEnabled.
  • Construir e manter integrações (REST/SOAP): callouts com Named Credentials, autenticação (OAuth/JWT), tratamento de erros e observabilidade (logs/monitoramento).
  • Atuar no ecossistema de Service Cloud & Digital Engagement (Chat, WhatsApp, Bots), integrando fluxos de atendimento e automações.
  • Realizar troubleshooting avançado (debug logs, trace flags, Event Monitoring) e otimizações de performance/consultas.
  • Versionar e implantar com SFDX + Git (branching, code review, qualidade de código).
  • Garantir segurança e compliance (FLS/CRUD, compartilhamento, transações) e produzir documentação técnica de suporte às entregas.

Requisitos obrigatórios:

  • Forte experiência como Desenvolvedor(a) Salesforce (Pleno/Sênior) com foco em Service Cloud.
  • Domínio de Apex, SOQL/SOSL, padrões assíncronos e testes unitários (qualidade e cobertura).
  • Experiência com LWC (JS moderno, componentização, comunicação com Apex).
  • Vivência com Digital Engagement (Chat/Messaging/WhatsApp), incluindo implementação técnica e integração com processos de atendimento.
  • Integrações via API REST/SOAP em Apex (Named Credentials, serialização JSON/XML, tratamento de exceções).
  • Troubleshooting e análise de logs em ambientes produtivos e sandboxes.
  • Conhecimento aprofundado de governor limits e estratégias de otimização.
  • Prática com Salesforce DX e Git (pull requests, code review).
  • Certificações: Platform Developer I

CLT, salário a combinar+ benefícios.

100% remoto.

- O que temos pra te oferecer?

Mais do que um plano de carreira!

A BRQ acredita que cada fera deve ser protagonista do seu crescimento, tendo autonomia para criar seu próprio plano de desenvolvimento profissional. Nosso plano de carreira é dividido em 4 pilares:

Carreira técnica: Você pode seguir a trilha de crescimento técnico, se o seu objetivo for se desenvolver cada vez mais em diferentes tecnologias. Oferecemos diversos treinamentos!

Carreira de Liderança: Você pode seguir a trilha e se tornar um líder, desenvolver pessoas, auxiliar na evolução profissional e pessoal e estimular o crescimento para o surgimento de novos talentos.

Experiência internacional: Estamos crescendo cada vez mais fora do Brasil e você tem possibilidade de atuar em projetos para outros países, ou diretamente nos países onde a BRQ tem sede.

Empreendedorismo: De funcionário para sócio! Temos o Innovation Hub, a Corporate Venture que investe em ideias de profissionais que tenham sinergia com nosso negócio.

- E os benefícios?

Plano de Saúde; Plano Odontológico; Seguro de Vida; Vale Refeição; Vale Alimentação; Horário Flexível; Gympass, Telemedicina, Telenutrição, Canal de suporte emocional 24h e muito mais!

- Como é trabalhar na BRQ?

Temos um clima descontraído, diversos programas e eventos internos. Adoramos comemorar! E fazemos isso muito bem! Veja aqui no Youtube: youtube.com/brqdigitalsolutions

Curtiu? Então inscreva-se e venha para o melhor da Transformação Digital com a gente!

title: Finance Business Partner | Accounts Receivable
description:
About Pinnacle Group

Pinnacle Group is a leading workforce solutions and technology services provider delivering innovative, results-driven solutions to global enterprises. With deep expertise in financial operations, staffing models, and program management, we help organizations optimize performance while maintaining strong compliance and operational excellence. Our finance team plays a critical role in supporting scalable growth, operational efficiency, and exceptional client experiences across diverse programs.

Summary

The Finance Business Partner will lead Pinnacle Group’s Accounts Receivable operations while serving as a strategic advisor to client-facing business teams. This role is approximately 70% operational, overseeing billing, collections, reconciliations, supplier payments, and team performance, and 30% focused on financial partnership and business support. The ideal candidate will bring strong leadership, analytical expertise, and a client-service mindset to improve AR performance and drive financial excellence. This position is instrumental in ensuring accurate cash flow management, client satisfaction, and continuous process improvement.

Job Description

Accounts Receivable Management

  • Oversee the full AR lifecycle including invoicing, collections, reconciliations, dispute resolution, and aging analysis.
  • Ensure accurate and timely billing while resolving client exceptions efficiently.
  • Monitor client payments, oversee cash application, and ensure timely settlement reconciliation to support 100% on-time supplier payment SLAs.
  • Partner with Accounts Payable and Treasury to align receivables with cash flow forecasts and payment schedules.
  • Monitor receivables aging and collaborate with client stakeholders and PMO teams to resolve payment inquiries.
  • Manage quarterly client and supplier volume rebates with precision and compliance.
  • Standardize AR policies, procedures, and playbooks across programs while maintaining audit readiness and strong internal controls.
  • Drive automation and continuous improvement initiatives to enhance AR efficiency and scalability.

Finance Business Partnering

  • Serve as the primary finance liaison to program leaders and account managers, supporting invoice-related issue resolution.
  • Provide actionable insights on billing behaviors, dispute trends, and invoicing challenges to improve program performance.
  • Present tailored AR reporting to leadership, highlighting risks, opportunities, and business impact.
  • Support onboarding of new client programs with structured billing guidance and financial playbooks.
  • Collaborate with Legal and Contracts to align billing terms and resolve disputes effectively.
  • Handle sensitive financial matters with discretion, urgency, and professionalism.

Team Management & Development

  • Lead and mentor a team of 2–4 AR analysts across onshore and offshore locations.
  • Manage hiring, training, workload distribution, and performance management in coordination with leadership.
  • Track and analyze AR KPIs including on-time billing, payment application, supplier payment SLAs, and resolution timelines.
  • Foster a culture of accountability, innovation, and proactive problem-solving.
  • Design and implement development plans to enhance team autonomy and operational excellence.

Technology & Systems

  • Manage AR modules within Workday and collaborate on system enhancements and integrations.
  • Review testing outcomes for system updates and approve AR-related production releases.
  • Contribute to the AR technology roadmap to support automation and process optimization initiatives.

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Business, or related field.
  • Minimum 5 years of management experience in Accounts Receivable or related financial operations.

title: Client Solutions Architect/Implementation and Onboarding Lead
description:
Job Title: Solutions Architect

Role Type: Full-Time Contract

Hours Per Week: 40

Working Hours: US Eastern Time Zone

Submit/Upload: English Resume Only

About The Methodical Group

The Methodical Group (TMG) is a global provider of IT services, consulting, and specialized staffing solutions, operating with a systematic and quality-driven approach for over 25 years. Headquartered in St. Petersburg, Florida, TMG supports organizations worldwide by delivering high-caliber technical talent and consulting expertise across industries such as technology, healthcare, logistics, and business services. Through our proprietary frameworks and rigorous recruiting methodology, we help clients scale their teams efficiently while ensuring strong alignment between business needs and technical capabilities.

Position Overview

Our client, a fast-growing technology company specializing in freight audit and business analytics solutions, is seeking a Solutions Architect to lead the technical delivery and implementation of their platform for new and existing customers.

This role sits within the Operations organization and focuses primarily on client implementation and solution delivery rather than software development . The Solutions Architect will serve as the primary technical lead for customer implementations, translating business requirements into platform configuration, coordinating delivery activities, and ensuring successful deployments.

Key Responsibilities & Qualifications

  • Lead end-to-end customer implementations , including discovery, requirements gathering, configuration, deployment, and post-go-live support, ensuring successful delivery of the platform.
  • Act as the primary technical point of contact for customers , managing technical discussions, delivery expectations, escalations, and implementation risks.
  • Translate business and operational requirements into implementation plans, platform configurations, and technical documentation .
  • Collaborate with internal teams to evaluate system integrations, operational requirements, and overall solution design for successful implementation.
  • Manage multiple implementation projects simultaneously , coordinating internal teams and ensuring project milestones and timelines are met.
  • Utilize SQL and system knowledge to troubleshoot issues, validate data, and support operational analysis during and after implementations.
  • Maintain clear documentation and delivery tracking using tools such as Jira, Confluence, Smartsheet, or similar project management and ticketing systems .
  • Communicate effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders while working collaboratively across departments involved in the implementation lifecycle.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Management Information Systems, Business, or a related field .
  • 4+ years of relevant experience in solutions architecture, implementation consulting, technical delivery, or similar client-facing technical roles.
  • Experience with software release processes and SDLC .
  • Familiarity with freight rate, freight audit, or logistics technology platforms is highly desirable.
  • Experience working with the Atlassian Suite (Jira, Confluence) is preferred.

title: Accounting Manager - US GAAP
description:
Lead US Accounting. Operate at a Global Standard.

  • MAVI is building a high-performance global finance network — embedding senior accounting leaders across LATAM directly into US leadership teams.
  • We are hiring experienced US Accounting Managers who are ready to operate as trusted finance partners to US CFOs and Controllers — owning close cycles, financial reporting, and operational excellence.

The Opportunity

You will serve as a direct extension of a US finance team, leading month-end close and overseeing reporting accuracy for high-growth and mid-market US companies.

This role is designed for senior professionals who want:

  • Direct collaboration with US leadership
  • High ownership and accountability
  • Exposure to global accounting standards
  • Long-term strategic partnership

What You Will Own

  • Lead and manage full month-end close under US GAAP
  • Oversee journal entries, reconciliations, and reporting packages
  • Ensure financial statements are accurate and timely
  • Supervise and guide accounting team members
  • Interface directly with US Controllers and CFOs
  • Strengthen reporting frameworks and internal controls
  • Drive process improvements and operational efficiency

What We’re Looking For

  • 6–8+ years of US GAAP accounting experience
  • Demonstrated leadership of close cycles
  • Experience managing or mentoring accounting teams
  • Strong financial reporting and GL expertise
  • Experience working directly with US stakeholders
  • ERP exposure (NetSuite preferred)
  • Strong professional English communication

Why Join MAVI

  • Operate at the same standard as US-based finance teams
  • Gain direct visibility with US leadership
  • Work on sophisticated, scaling businesses
  • Be part of a curated global network of senior accounting professionals

This Role Is Ideal For

  • Senior accounting leaders in LATAM who want more than transactional accounting — and are ready to operate as strategic finance partners within US organizations.

title: Senior Java Developer
description:
About Us :

Sportingtech is a multi-award-winning provider of turnkey betting and gaming solutions designed for regulated and emerging markets around the world. With offices in Malta, Bulgaria, London, Brazil and Portugal, our iGaming platform offers everything covering sportsbook and casino via a modular system and intuitive back office for a fully omni-channel solution. Our unparalleled ability to cater for local-market customisation and operator preferences provides players with an optimal betting experience, resulting in proven growth for our rapidly expanding customer base.

Where you Fit In

You'll be a key player within the Sportingtech Team and joining a group of highly skilled professionals, with a pivotal responsibility in creating performing and scalable Java-based solutions across our award-winning iGaming Platform.

Who are You ?

As a Senior Java developer you'll become a part of our multinational Scrum teams to create state-of-the-art software solutions. In all teams we cooperate with internal and external experts from different knowledge domains to discover and build the best solutions possible.

Technologies Used:

Java 8+, Spring Boot, RabbitMQ, Kafka, JDBC, NoSQL, Relational Databases, PostgreSQL, AWS, Dynatrace

The Impact you will have:

  • Software Development: Collaborate with cross-functional teams, architects, and other stakeholders to design, develop, test, and deploy robust Java applications
  • Code Quality: Write clean, maintainable, and efficient code while following best practices and coding standards. Also guide less senior engineers towards Test driven development.
  • Technical Analysis: Analyze and troubleshoot complex technical issues, providing innovative solutions and improvements.
  • Documentation: Create and maintain comprehensive technical documentation to aid in code understanding and future enhancements.
  • Collaboration: Work closely with team members, including architects, developers, and QA’s, to deliver high-quality software in a timely fashion. Also mentor in different areas less experienced engineers.
  • Performance Optimization: Identify and implement performance enhancements, scalability improvements, and code optimizations.
  • Technology Stack: Stay up to date with the latest Java-related technologies and frameworks to recommend and implement the best solutions.

title: Supervisor de Experiência
description:
Quando você pensa na Riachuelo, você pensa em nossas lojas, correto? Mas já parou para pensar o que acontece até nossas lojas receberem as coleções que conquistam o Brasil ano após ano?

Hoje somos mais de 30 mil criadores de possibilidades espalhados por todo o território nacional, atuando em diversas áreas construindo a Moda que inspira o Brasil.

Além das mais de 430 lojas das marcas Riachuelo, Casa Riachuelo, Fan Lab e Carter´s, c ontamos com times de Corporativo, Fábrica, Centro de distribuições, Contact Center e da nossa financeira, a Midway e muitas outras frentes que atuam juntas em um modelo de negócio integrado que garante que sejamos únicos no mercado brasileiro.

Trabalhamos com moda para criar impacto positivo diretamente em nosso país e amamos o que fazemos . A nossa cultura guia nossas ações e nossas relações, reforçando nossa essência brasileira, acolhedora e empreendedora.


Nosso time de Loja está em busca de um Supervisor Vendas Assistidas para compor a

equipe!


Lembramos que nossas oportunidades são para todos. Na Riachuelo, você encontra

um ambiente diverso, com respeito e empatia, em que cuidamos dos RCHLOVERS.

Responsabilidades e atribuições:

Os desafios da função são:


Responsável pelos departamentos de perfumaria, eletrônicos, óculos ou relógios, realizando a gestão da equipe, garantindo a execução dos procedimentos operacionais e a entrega dos resultados.


  • Mobilizar e treinar sua equipe para o melhor atendimento ao cliente;
  • Garantir o cumprimento das metas estabelecidas;
  • Diagnosticar e propor alternativas que melhorem resultados;
  • Garantir a execução de procedimentos operacionais, alterações de preços, reposição de produtos e organização dos departamentos;
  • Garantir a aplicação dos procedimentos operacionais, entre eles, recebimento, armazenamento, reposição de produtos, trocas e balanços;
  • Acompanhar a concorrência, sugerir ações comerciais e melhoria em produtos;
  • Oferecer o cartão Riachuelo e os produtos financeiros aos clientes, mobilizando sua equipe para este fim;
  • Definir planejamento de horários, escalas e banco de horas da loja junto com equipe gerencial;
  • Conduzir reuniões com a equipe de loja;
  • Selecionar e treinar novos colaboradores;
  • Aplicar treinamentos conforme padrão da empresa;
  • Realizar a avaliação de desempenho e feedback para colaboradores;
  • Identificar e desenvolver os talentos para sucessão (PRI);
  • Acompanhar visitas de outras áreas da empresa.

Requisitos e qualificações:

É muito importante que você tenha e/ou saiba:


  • Formação superior completa ou cursando.
  • Disponibilidade de horários para fechamento de loja, finais de semana e feriados.
  • Experiência com telefonia e perfumaria.

Informações adicionais:

E quais são os benefícios?


  • Assistência médica
  • Assistência odontológica
  • Seguro de vida em grupo
  • Totalpass
  • Parcerias educacionais
  • Descontos na Riachuelo
  • Vale Refeição ou Alimentação
  • Vale Transporte
  • Participação nos lucros e resultados

title: Arquiteto Pré-vendas
description:
Arquiteto de Soluções em Aplicações em Pré-vendas


O que buscamos:

Profissional dinâmico e antenado, com forte conhecimento na elaboração de propostas técnicas, especialmente em soluções que envolvem Inteligência Artificial (IA). O candidato deve ser capaz de orquestrar processos de concorrência (BIDs), entender as necessidades dos clientes e traduzir essas demandas em soluções viáveis e rentáveis. É essencial ter habilidades de comunicação e trabalho em equipe, além de ser orientado a resultados e cumprir prazos.


Requisitos e Qualificações:

- Experiência em processos de concorrências e licitações (RFPs, RFIs, RFQs, pregões eletrônicos).

- Conhecimento em TI e transformação digital, desenvolvimento de software, e modernização de aplicações.

- Familiaridade com serviços de API, integração de dados, e IA.

- Capacidade de desenvolver propostas técnicas com escopo, arquitetura, entregáveis e metodologias.

- Modernização, Sustentação de ambientes de desenvolvimento.

- Métricas e indicadores de pré-vendas de ambientes de desenvolvimento (ponto de função, posto de trabalho, etc)

- Comunicação clara e escrita técnica para elaboração de propostas.

- Fluência em inglês e espanhol (intermediário/avançado).

- Experiência em planejamento, organização de tarefas e gerenciamento de equipes multifuncionais.


Diferenciais:

- Experiência em projetos de transformação digital e propostas inovadoras com IA.

- Certificações em métricas e áreas relacionadas a APIs, Data, Analytics e IA.

- Conhecimento em plataformas de APIs e estruturação de custos para formação de preços.

- Habilidade em identificar e mitigar riscos financeiros, legais e operacionais em BIDs.

- Capacidade de apresentar soluções para públicos não técnicos e demonstrar benefícios de propostas em relação à concorrência.

title: Sénior C++ Architect (Relocation to Portugal)
description:
Your connection with Aubay starts in the following lines:

Aubay Portugal is a multinational French company, in Portugal since 2007. We have offices in Lisbon and Oporto and we are a specialized consultant in Management, Implementation, Development and Maintenance of Information Systems. We have more than 150 active partners and we operate in sectors such as banking, insurance, telecommunications, services, energy and transports.

What are we looking for?

  • +6 years significant experience with C++ (preferably C++11 or later);
  • Experience using GNU/Linux for development, shell scripting, and basic administration;
  • Strong knowledge of object-oriented programming languages and software architectures;
  • Experience with embedded systems;
  • Solid understanding of distributed software architectures;
  • Willingness to relocate to Portugal;
  • C1 English is mandatory.

What do we have to offer you?

  • Health Insurance;
  • Feedback&Coffee – the system that includes Aubay’s Performance Management Cycle, with regular moments of feedback and the Career Progression Model;
  • Working model: hybrid/remote/on-site;
  • A Training Academy designed to think of you and your needs. You can count on technical and behavioural training sessions (e-Learning and classroom), Meet&Techs, Webinars and Mentoring;
  • Events and Teambuildings.

What makes us different?

  • Our organizational culture is based on values such as transparency, team spirit, regular feedback and continuous learning;
  • Reference prizes and birthday present;
  • We don’t have a dress code;
  • We know your name and all address each other informally;
  • You will grow in good company. Isn’t this one of the ways in which to develop professionally?

If we got your attention, we now hope to spark your enthusiasm. Ready for the first phase? We are waiting for you:

Personal Data collected by AUBAY PORTUGAL as Data Controller, regarding the identification, contact and professional capabilities of the candidates, in the present procedure, will be processed for the application analysis, having in consideration that the processing is conducted in order to to take the steps, at the request of the data subject, prior to entering into a contract;

Personal data sent through the present application will be kept by Aubay during the application procedure and will remain stored whilst updated (for two years period). The collected data might be transferred or include other processing actitivites, as long as the data subject is informed, in the occurrence of a standard application and selection procedure, for the compliance of legal obligations for the time required by law. For any queries or request regarding personal data protection rights, the Data Subject may contact AUBAY PORTUGAL’s headquarters in Avenida Duque D`Ávila, nº46 em Lisboa or use the DPO’s e-mail - . The Data Subject also has the right to file a complaint with the National Data Protection Authority – (please do not include data regarding racial or ethnical origins, political opinions, religion, philosophy, biometrical data, health data, sexual life and orientation, or relating to o criminal convictions and offences.)

title: Shopify Solution Architect
description:
Job Title: Shopify Solution Architect

Location: Remote

Mode of Hire: Contract

Role Overview

We are seeking an experienced e-commerce Solution Architect to design, scale, and optimize modern digital commerce ecosystems. This role will be responsible for building secure, scalable, and high-performing architecture that supports enterprise-level eCommerce operations.

The ideal candidate will bring deep expertise in Shopify and Adobe Magento, along with strong experience integrating complex systems across enterprise environments. You will work closely with engineering, product, marketing, and operations teams to ensure the eCommerce platform integrates seamlessly with core business systems and supports business growth.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design and implement scalable e-commerce architecture supporting enterprise digital commerce operations.
  • Lead platform architecture and integration strategies for Shopify and Adobe Magento environments.
  • Manage and optimize Shopify within a large, regulated enterprise environment, ensuring secure and reliable integrations.
  • Architect integrations between TikTok Shop and Shopify, including catalog management, order processing, and fulfillment workflows.
  • Oversee end-to-end e-commerce data flows including checkout, purchase orders, abandoned cart processes, and customer transactions.
  • Design integrations with enterprise systems such as SAP, APIs, and analytics/data platforms.
  • Ensure reliable data pipelines to analytics platforms such as Snowflake and other data warehouses.
  • Collaborate with product, engineering, and marketing teams to align technical architecture with business objectives.
  • Evaluate and implement digital experience tools that enhance customer engagement and conversion.
  • Ensure best practices around security, performance, scalability, and system reliability across the commerce ecosystem.

Required Qualifications

  • 8+ years of experience in eCommerce architecture, platform engineering, or solution architecture roles.
  • Strong experience with Shopify and Adobe Magento platforms in enterprise environments.
  • Proven experience designing and managing complex system integrations using APIs and middleware.
  • Experience integrating TikTok Shop with Shopify, including catalog, order, and fulfillment processes.
  • Deep understanding of end-to-end eCommerce operations, including checkout flows, purchase orders, and abandoned cart workflows.
  • Experience integrating eCommerce platforms with ERP systems such as SAP.
  • Strong understanding of data architecture and analytics integrations, including Snowflake or similar platforms.
  • Experience working within regulated enterprise environments with strong security and compliance requirements.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with Customer Data Platforms (CDPs) and digital experience tools.
  • Familiarity with marketing automation and engagement platforms such as: Yotpo, Simon, Attentive
  • Experience with SMS, email marketing platforms, and customer reviews tools within the eCommerce ecosystem.
  • Strong understanding of modern composable commerce architecture.
  • Experience working with cross-functional teams across engineering, product, and marketing.

Key Skills

  • eCommerce Architecture
  • Shopify & Magento Platform Expertise
  • API & System Integrations
  • Enterprise Data Architecture
  • ERP Integrations (SAP)
  • Digital Experience Platforms
  • Cloud & Scalable Infrastructure
  • Cross-functional Technical Leadership

title: Human Resources Business Partner Manager (HRBP)
description:
Who we are

Keeta is the international subsidiary of Meituan, a global giant in the delivery sector, and we’re on a bold mission: to revolutionize food and consumer goods delivery around the world. Our motto is simple yet powerful: “We help people eat better, live better.”

With innovation and technology at our core, Keeta is expanding rapidly — with over 1,000 employees worldwide — and you can be part of this global journey.

About the position

We are looking for a HRBP Manager to join our HR team in Brazil .

You will report directly to the HR Lead in Brazil and collaborate with a lean, high-impact team responsible for different business lines and strategic projects.

This is a hands-on role, ideal for someone comfortable operating in high-growth, 0→1 environments , balancing strategy, execution, and stakeholder management.

Job Responsibilities:

Organizational Optimization:

  • Assist business leaders in building an efficient organizational structure for Keeta, facilitating alignment of goals within the management team.
  • Regularly conduct organizational diagnostics to identify key issues and challenges, and proactively follow up on solutions.

Talent Development:

  • Utilize talent review, development, and co-creation facilitation methods to focus on the recruitment, training, development, and advancement of key talents.
  • Provide strong talent pipeline support and help build talent succession plans for business departments.

Culture Implementation:

  • Drive the implementation and promotion of corporate culture and values within the department.
  • Regularly organize employee engagement and care activities to communicate company philosophy and values, strengthening team cohesion and morale.

Strategic Partnership:

  • Gain deep understanding of the business strategy of the international team.
  • Participate in the entire process from strategy formulation to execution, and develop tailored HR plans to achieve both short- and long-term business objectives.

Job Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree or above, with over 3 years of HR experience; experience supporting international teams is preferred.
  • Fluent in English, with strong written and verbal communication skills; able to communicate efficiently with international teams and partners.
  • Strong logical thinking and learning ability, solid HR fundamentals, self-driven, curious, and able to work under pressure.

Job Highlights:

  • Opportunity to participate in the building of an international team, broaden your horizons, and work with global talent.
  • Fast-growing business with great personal development potential; work alongside a professional and high-caliber HR team.

Nice to have

  • Experience working in Chinese companies or multicultural, Asia-influenced environments.

Interested in joining Keeta?

Check out our open positions! When applying, your information will be securely stored and may be shared with Keeta and its global affiliates.

title: Senior Full Stack Developer
description:
A Jusfy está em busca de uma pessoa Senior Full Stack Developer com forte atuação em backend e experiência em contextos de pagamentos para compor o time de tecnologia.


Somos uma empresa jovem e muito promissora. Alcançamos resultados expressivos de crescimento nos últimos anos e sabemos que temos ainda muito mais para conquistar. Buscamos profissionais que queiram fazer parte dessa trajetória junto conosco!


Responsabilidades:

  • Desenvolver novas funcionalidades utilizando ReactJS e APIs RESTful, com forte atuação em backend utilizando Node.js e Express, principalmente em soluções relacionadas ao contexto de pagamentos;
  • Escrever códigos limpos, de alta qualidade e fácil manutenção seguindo as boas práticas de desenvolvimento;
  • Colaborar com a equipe de tecnologia (Engenharia, Produto e Design) para o sucesso dos projetos;
  • Participar ativamente em discussões de arquitetura e tecnologias;
  • Realizar code reviews, ajudando outros desenvolvedores a melhorar a qualidade do código;
  • Garantir que a documentação do código e arquitetura esteja sempre atualizada.


Requisitos técnicos:

  • Experiência com desenvolvimento de Backend e Frontend, com maior profundidade em backend;
  • Experiência em Typescript e API REST;
  • Experiência ou vivência com integrações e contextos de pagamentos (gateways, billing, recorrência, webhooks ou similares);
  • Conhecimento em bancos de dados relacionais e não-relacionais;
  • Orquestração de containers (Docker e docker-compose);
  • Conhecimento em Styled Components e Context API;
  • Experiência com controle de versão utilizando Git.


Desejável:

  • Experiência com metodologias ágeis;
  • Experiência em times de desenvolvimento de software ou empresas de tecnologia;
  • Conhecimento em testes automatizados e ferramentas de integração contínua;
  • Conhecimento de Design Patterns;
  • Habilidade para trabalhar em equipe e boa comunicação;
  • Boa habilidade de resolução de problemas e pensamento crítico.


Modelo de Contratação:

PJ


Oferecemos :

Cartão flexível de benefícios.

Rotina remota de trabalho;

Ambiente de trabalho descontraído e inovador;

Oportunidade de trabalhar em projetos desafiadores e com grande impacto.



Como se candidatar

Valorizamos perspectivas diversas e incentivamos a candidatura de pessoas com diferentes experiências. Se você é uma pessoa desenvolvedora sênior e está buscando uma oportunidade desafiadora em uma empresa inovadora, se candidate na oportunidade.

title: AI-Augmented Software Engineer
description:
AI-Augmented Software Engineer

Python | JavaScript | Cloud | AI Coding Agents

We are looking for a Software Engineer who builds software with AI as a core part of the development workflow.

This role is not for engineers who occasionally use Copilot . We are looking for developers who already work in an AI-augmented engineering environment , using tools such as Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot, or other AI coding agents to significantly accelerate development.

You should be comfortable allowing AI to generate large portions of code , while maintaining full responsibility for architecture, quality, and system reliability .

title: Delphi Developer
description:
*ROLE BASED IN IRELAND, MUST BE INTERESTED IN RELOCATION*

Our client are looking for a Senior Delphi developer to join their growing team. Our client are a progressive software company who market their own product suites which are both desktop and web based.

Main Technologies

Borland Delphi

Web technologies, HTML, DHTML and Javascript

Oracle, SQLServer, MySQL

Primary Objectives

You will be responsible for the development of core and customer specific elements of the product suite. You will also contribute to the design and development of new modules within the system.   • Issue investigation,
  • Software maintenance,
  • Documentation,
  • Other duties as assigned

Required Skills

  • Experience in working in an n-tier web development environment
  • Working knowledge of SQL and database design
  • Excellent communication, problem solving and analytical skills
  • Must be able to work effectively individually and as part of a team

Desirable Skills

Experience in any other OO-based development environments (C++, C#, Java etc.)

title: Business Development Representative
description:
Eracore is an electrical engineering and BIM company delivering complex Electrical BIM models for large construction projects across the U.S. Our team brings together top talent to work on some of the most interesting and technically demanding electrical projects including data centers, government facilities, industrial buildings, and advanced commercial projects.

We are proud of the work we do, and we invite you to take a look:

Role Overview

We are looking for a Business Development Representative (BDR) / Sales Representative to drive outbound sales and generate new business opportunities. The ideal candidate will be responsible for prospecting, outreach, and lead generation, helping expand our client base for software and engineering services.

Key Responsibilities

  • Identify and prospect potential clients through LinkedIn, email outreach, cold calling, and other outbound channels
  • Build and manage a pipeline of qualified leads
  • Conduct initial discovery calls to understand client needs
  • Schedule meetings and demos for senior sales or technical teams
  • Maintain CRM records and track outreach activities
  • Collaborate with marketing and sales teams to improve outreach strategies
  • Research target industries and companies to identify potential opportunities
  • Achieve and exceed monthly lead generation and pipeline targets

Requirements

  • 2+ years experience in business development, sales, or lead generation
  • Experience in B2B outbound sales
  • Strong communication and negotiation skills
  • Experience using CRM tools (HubSpot, Salesforce, etc.)
  • Ability to manage high-volume outreach campaigns
  • Self-motivated with strong organizational skills

title: JR Partnership Programs Specialist
description:
We are looking for a full-time, remote Partnership Programs Specialist with a strong communication skills and background in sales to join our U.S. client. The right candidates will play a vital role in supporting and executing partnership initiatives that drive growth and value for our client. Reporting to the Director of Partnerships, this role focuses on coordinating and implementing partnership programs, ensuring seamless execution and alignment with strategic goals.

The Partner Programs Specialist is responsible for providing accurate information about the company and its services. The specialist is required to keep accurate records of all time spent on calls, as well as customer-related questions or assistance. All phone calls are recorded.

Our client is on a mission provide technology and services that enable veterinary practices to provide the highest quality of care to pet owners. The company is well-funded, growth-stage company comprising individuals that thrive in a fast-paced, passionate, and entrepreneurial environment. Our client has thousands (and counting) of veterinarians within its customer base today.


Responsibilities

  • Engage with customers and prospects via phone, email, and messaging to generate sales
  • Leveraging various platforms and tools such as Salesforce, Salesloft, Chorus, Chili Piper, and more
  • Make a minimum of 40 outbound calls per day as well as send nurture emails promoting our client's value
  • Meet and exceed monthly goals
  • Work with multiple internal teams to ensure that the customer experience is seamless


Required Experience

  • Excellent English communication skills
  • 1-3 years of call center sales or remote sales experience
  • Highly motivated with a strong sense of ambition, self-discipline, and a commitment to both personal and professional development
  • Confident, energetic, and skilled communicator
  • Team player, who excels in cross-departmental collaboration
  • Driven by a competitive spirit and a passion for success!
  • Commitment to constant learning and continual growth as our client builds a better veterinary experience together, and are looking for people who will make our culture and technology even better
  • A collaborative approach, a can-do attitude, and a relentless pursuit to attain goals and solve problems
  • Trustworthy, team-oriented, and transparent


Desired Experience

  • Experience working in the veterinary space and/or sales


Additional Information

  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with smart and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Lets learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • Start: ASAP


About Velozient

We are a privately held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent that enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We are focused on providing world-class remote resources to work as valued client team members. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

title: Senior Technical Business Analyst
description:
Elastacloud (An Acora Group Company) Overview

Elastacloud (An Acoura Group Company) are a progressive full-stack full-service business technology services partner, built for the AI era. Combining the capabilities of a Managed Service Provider (MSP), Managed Security Service Provider (MSSP), IT Consulting, Professional Services and Development company, Acora helps customers achieve breakthrough results - often quicker and at lower risk than they thought possible.


We believe in a better working world, where our customers are confident to fully embrace the AI opportunity and generate economic impact.


Role Overview

We are looking for a Senior Technical Business Analyst with strong hands-on experience in data, AI-driven projects and software, particularly in Data Transformation initiatives.


This professional will act as a bridge between business stakeholders and technical teams, translating complex business needs into well-structured technical requirements and user stories. The role requires someone highly technical, delivery-oriented, and comfortable operating in Agile environments, including leading Scrum ceremonies and acting as Project Manager when required.


The position involves daily interaction with teams in Australia and regular contact with the UK, so strong English communication skills and time zone flexibility are essential.

Role Responsibilities

  • Lead requirement gathering sessions with business stakeholders (Australia & UK).
  • Translate business needs into clear, structured, and technically detailed user stories.
  • Define functional and non-functional requirements for data and AI solutions.
  • Work closely with data engineers, software engineers, architects, and AI specialists.
  • Design and document data flows, process maps, integration points, and system dependencies.
  • Support Data Transformation initiatives (data migration, data modelling, governance, pipelines).
  • Define acceptance criteria and validation rules.
  • Conduct backlog refinement sessions and prioritisation workshops.
  • Lead Scrum ceremonies (planning, refinement, daily, review, retrospective).
  • Act as Project Manager when needed (timeline tracking, risk management, stakeholder reporting).
  • Support UAT coordination and solution validation.
  • Ensure alignment between business objectives and technical delivery.
  • Manage documentation in tools such as DevOps, Jira or similar.

Key Skills, Knowledge & Experience

  • 5+ years of experience as Business Analyst in technical/software projects.
  • Proven experience in Data projects.
  • Technical background in:
  • Data architecture concepts
  • APIs & system integrations
  • Cloud environments (Azure, AWS or GCP)
  • Data modelling methodologies (BEAM, Kimbal, etc.)
  • Experience working in AI-related initiatives (ML models, automation, data pipelines, or analytics projects).
  • Experience writing detailed technical user stories for engineering teams.
  • Hands-on experience working with Agile/Scrum methodology.
  • Experience leading Scrum ceremonies.
  • Previous experience as a Project Manager would be beneficial but is not required. The core skills we are looking for are related to a Business Analyst with a focus on Data.
  • Strong stakeholder management skills.
  • Excellent written and verbal English (mandatory).
  • Availability to work overlapping with Australia (preferably 13:00–22:00 BRT).



Our Values

We’re proud to share the values we live by. They’re not dusty abstract concepts. Our values define our culture: they act as a promise to our customers and a constant challenge to ourselves, both as individuals and as a team, to be Game-Changers.

#1 Be the best you can be

We challenge ourselves to raise our game each day. By embracing a mindset of growth, we continuously strive to improve ourselves, our ways of working, and the service we deliver to our customers.


#2 We do what we say.

When we make a promise, we follow-through - no excuses. We don’t leave anyone hanging or walk away from challenges. Reliable and focused, we value clear communication to build trust and give customers, and colleagues, the confidence they can count on us every time.


#3 Together we win.

Business is the biggest team sport of them all. By communicating well, breaking down silos and staying aligned, we create clarity and focus. Strong relationships, shared goals and commitment make us a winning team – for each other and for our customers.


Equal Opportunities at Acora

Acora is an equal opportunity employer, committed to providing equal opportunities regardless of race or ethnic origin, gender identity, family situation, sexual orientation, disability, religion or age. We hire our people on the basis of qualifications, merit, skills, and business need.


Acora is a Level 1 Disability Confident Committed Employer and will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, perform essential job functions, and receive equitable benefits and all privileges of employment. Please contact us to request any reasonable adjustments.


Join us at Acora in creating a workplace where everyone can succeed and make an impact. We look forward to welcoming you to our team!

title: Senior Technical Business Analyst
description:
Elastacloud (An Acora Group Company) Overview

Elastacloud (An Acoura Group Company) are a progressive full-stack full-service business technology services partner, built for the AI era. Combining the capabilities of a Managed Service Provider (MSP), Managed Security Service Provider (MSSP), IT Consulting, Professional Services and Development company, Acora helps customers achieve breakthrough results - often quicker and at lower risk than they thought possible.


We believe in a better working world, where our customers are confident to fully embrace the AI opportunity and generate economic impact.


Role Overview

We are looking for a Senior Technical Business Analyst with strong hands-on experience in data, AI-driven projects and software, particularly in Data Transformation initiatives.


This professional will act as a bridge between business stakeholders and technical teams, translating complex business needs into well-structured technical requirements and user stories. The role requires someone highly technical, delivery-oriented, and comfortable operating in Agile environments, including leading Scrum ceremonies and acting as Project Manager when required.


The position involves daily interaction with teams in Australia and regular contact with the UK, so strong English communication skills and time zone flexibility are essential.

Role Responsibilities

  • Lead requirement gathering sessions with business stakeholders (Australia & UK).
  • Translate business needs into clear, structured, and technically detailed user stories.
  • Define functional and non-functional requirements for data and AI solutions.
  • Work closely with data engineers, software engineers, architects, and AI specialists.
  • Design and document data flows, process maps, integration points, and system dependencies.
  • Support Data Transformation initiatives (data migration, data modelling, governance, pipelines).
  • Define acceptance criteria and validation rules.
  • Conduct backlog refinement sessions and prioritisation workshops.
  • Lead Scrum ceremonies (planning, refinement, daily, review, retrospective).
  • Act as Project Manager when needed (timeline tracking, risk management, stakeholder reporting).
  • Support UAT coordination and solution validation.
  • Ensure alignment between business objectives and technical delivery.
  • Manage documentation in tools such as DevOps, Jira or similar.

Key Skills, Knowledge & Experience

  • 5+ years of experience as Business Analyst in technical/software projects.
  • Proven experience in Data projects.
  • Technical background in:
  • Data architecture concepts
  • APIs & system integrations
  • Cloud environments (Azure, AWS or GCP)
  • Data modelling methodologies (BEAM, Kimbal, etc.)
  • Experience working in AI-related initiatives (ML models, automation, data pipelines, or analytics projects).
  • Experience writing detailed technical user stories for engineering teams.
  • Hands-on experience working with Agile/Scrum methodology.
  • Experience leading Scrum ceremonies.
  • Previous experience as a Project Manager would be beneficial but is not required. The core skills we are looking for are related to a Business Analyst with a focus on Data.
  • Strong stakeholder management skills.
  • Excellent written and verbal English (mandatory).
  • Availability to work overlapping with Australia (preferably 13:00–22:00 BRT).



Our Values

We’re proud to share the values we live by. They’re not dusty abstract concepts. Our values define our culture: they act as a promise to our customers and a constant challenge to ourselves, both as individuals and as a team, to be Game-Changers.

#1 Be the best you can be

We challenge ourselves to raise our game each day. By embracing a mindset of growth, we continuously strive to improve ourselves, our ways of working, and the service we deliver to our customers.


#2 We do what we say.

When we make a promise, we follow-through - no excuses. We don’t leave anyone hanging or walk away from challenges. Reliable and focused, we value clear communication to build trust and give customers, and colleagues, the confidence they can count on us every time.


#3 Together we win.

Business is the biggest team sport of them all. By communicating well, breaking down silos and staying aligned, we create clarity and focus. Strong relationships, shared goals and commitment make us a winning team – for each other and for our customers.

Please contact us to request any reasonable adjustments.

title: Desenvolvedor Full Stack (JavaScript, React, Node.js)
description:
Desenvolvedor Full Stack Typescript | React | Node

Modelo de contratação: PJ (sem benefícios)

Trabalho: 100% remoto

⏱ Dedicação: Fulltime

O que você vai fazer no dia a dia

Frontend (React/Next.js)

  • Desenvolver interfaces dinâmicas com forte integração de APIs
  • Criar componentes reutilizáveis utilizando hooks nativos do React (useState, useEffect, useContext, useCallback, useMemo)
  • Gerenciar estado global com Zustand
  • Trabalhar com TanStack Query para consumo eficiente de APIs
  • Utilizar shadcn/ui e Tailwind CSS para componentes

Backend (Node.js/Fastify)

  • Construir e manter APIs RESTful
  • Trabalhar com Drizzle ORM e PostgreSQL
  • Integrar serviços externos (Buckets, RabbitMQ)
Stack Tecnológica

Frontend

  • Next.js + React
  • TypeScript
  • Zustand (gerenciamento de estado)
  • TanStack Query
  • shadcn/ui + Tailwind CSS

Backend

  • Node.js + TypeScript
  • Fastify
  • Drizzle ORM
  • PostgreSQL
  • RabbitMQ
  • Integração com Buckets/Storage
Requisitos Obrigatórios
  • Experiência sólida com TypeScript
  • Domínio de React (hooks, contexts, gerenciamento de estado)
  • Conhecimento em construção de APIs REST
  • Experiência com banco de dados relacional (PostgreSQL)
Diferenciais
  • Docker
  • Python (manipulação de arquivos)
  • Experiência com message brokers (RabbitMQ)

title: Vendedor
description:
Descrição da Empresa : A Mentoria Doc10X é um Clube de Mentoria Digital focada no crescimento de carreiras de médicos que já possuem consultórios ou clínicas. Atualmente com quase 70 médicos, somos um dos Clubes Sócios da Mentoring League Society.

Integral

CLT

Júnior

R$ 3.000,00 - R$ 15.000,00

São José do Rio Preto, SP

Término das inscrições: 21/03/2026

Descrição do cargo

Estamos em busca de um closer para conduzir negociações estratégicas, desde a prospecção, passando pelo agendamento e o call de vendas de novos médicos para a Mentoria. O closer ficará responsável pelos leads gerados por funis e os que ja estão em nossos bancos de dados, garantindo a conversão de tais leads qualificados e o crescimento sustentável da empresa. O profissional será responsável por entender as necessidades dos clientes, oferecer soluções personalizadas e garantir uma experiência de compra excepcional.

Responsabilidades

Realizar negociações e fechar vendas, garantindo alta taxa de conversão.

Gerenciar o pipeline de vendas, acompanhando todas as etapas do processo comercial.

Entender as dores e necessidades do cliente, oferecendo soluções personalizadas.

Atuar em conjunto com SDRs e equipe de marketing, garantindo a qualidade dos leads.

Registrar e atualizar informações no CRM, acompanhando métricas e indicadores de performance.

Manter um relacionamento próximo com os clientes, garantindo retenção e recompra.

Aplicar técnicas avançadas de persuasão e fechamento para potencializar os resultados.

Requisitos

Habilidade de negociação e persuasão para conduzir conversas de fechamento.

Capacidade de comunicação clara e assertiva, garantindo confiança na negociação.

Proatividade e resiliência para lidar com objeções e desafios do processo comercial.

Organização e gestão do tempo para acompanhar leads e garantir follow-ups eficientes.

Familiaridade com metodologias de vendas, como SPIN Selling e Inside Sales.

Experiência em vendas consultivas ou negociação de alto valor.

O mais importante: ter ambiçao e ao mesmo tempo humildade, pois será treinado diretamente pelo CEO da empresa

Diferenciais

Histórico comprovado de boa performance em fechamento de vendas.

Experiência com produtos de alto ticket e mercados B2C.

Vivência com CRMs e ferramentas de automação comercial.

Capacidade de adaptação a diferentes perfis de clientes e segmentos de mercado.

Conhecimento em gatilhos mentais aplicados a vendas.

title: Engenheiro de Dados PL
description:
Se você gosta de desafios e quer mostrar todo o seu potencial, queremos te conhecer! A Vericode preza por um time inclusivo e repleto de diversidade, nas suas mais variadas representações. Todas as nossas vagas estão abertas para pessoas com deficiência!

#VemSerVericoder

Responsabilidades e atribuições:

  • Construir, evoluir e sustentar pipelines de dados em AWS (S3, Glue, EMR, Redshift), priorizando custos, confiabilidade e observabilidade.
  • Orquestrar cargas incrementais/idempotentes no Apache Airflow (MWAA), com SLAs, retries, backfill e alertas.
  • Desenvolver jobs AWS Glue (PySpark) com tratamento de schema evolution, particionamento, tuning e uso do Glue Data Catalog.
  • Modelar camadas Bronze/Silver/Gold (Medallion) e Dimensional (Star/Snowflake) para consumo analítico.
  • Atuar em SQL Server/SSIS (on‑prem) em migrações/modernizações e integrações com o lake na AWS.
  • Escrever código limpo em Python/PySpark, YAML para DAGs/configs e praticar CI/CD (testes, code review, versionamento).
  • Colaborar com times de produto/negócio, traduzindo requisitos em soluções de dados com métricas e contratos claros.

Requisitos e qualificações:

Hard Skills (Obrigatórias)

  • AWS: S3, Glue (jobs/crawlers/Catalog), EMR (Spark), Redshift, Athena (desejável).
  • Airflow/MWAA: DAGs parametrizadas, sensors/operators AWS, backfill e monitoramento.
  • SQL ANSI: joins, window functions, CTEs, `MERGE`, tuning básico.
  • On‑prem: SQL Server (T‑SQL), SSIS (ETL).
  • Modelagem: Medallion (Bronze/Silver/Gold) e Dimensional (Star Schema, Snowflake).
  • Python e PySpark (RDD/DataFrame API), particionamento e file sizing.
  • YAML para configs de pipelines e CI/CD (GitHub/GitLab, testes e deploy).
  • Kubernetes (básico): conceitos de pod/deployment e operação de workloads de dados (desejável).

Soft Skills (com foco em clientes e resiliência)

  • Comunicação com clientes internos: explicar soluções de dados em linguagem simples e foco em valor.
  • Resiliência operacional: manter a calma e priorizar ações durante incidentes (falhas de pipeline/SLAs).
  • Colaboração e negociação com múltiplos stakeholders (produtos, risco, compliance).
  • Mindset investigativo e resolução de problemas com documentação clara e pós‑mortem objetivo.

Diferenciais

  • Experiência com Trino.
  • Boas práticas de FinOps e monitoramento (CloudWatch/Prometheus).
  • Noções de segurança/mascaramento em camadas de consumo.

Benefícios:

  • Reembolso de Capacitações Técnicas: Cobertura de 100% para certificações profissionais, além de reembolso para cursos de capacitação técnica;

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
We are currently looking for a Senior Data Engineer to join a high-performing engineering team supporting multiple global consulting engagements. This role is ideal for engineers who enjoy building scalable data systems, working closely with stakeholders, and delivering production-ready solutions.

You will collaborate with multidisciplinary teams to design and implement modern data architectures while supporting analytics and business decision-making.


Key Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and optimize data pipelines and distributed data systems.
  • Build and maintain ETL workflows across multiple systems.
  • Deliver production-ready data solutions , from prototype to enterprise-grade systems.
  • Partner with consulting and business teams to translate requirements into technical solutions.
  • Lead analytics modules and clearly communicate technical outcomes.
  • Ensure scalability, reliability, and performance of data infrastructure.


Requirements

  • Intermediate to upper-intermediate English level (B2 minimum).
  • 6+ years professional experience as a Data Engineer.
  • Strong experience with Python and SQL.
  • Experience with relational databases (PostgreSQL, MySQL, MariaDB or similar).
  • Experience with NoSQL databases (MongoDB, Redis, Neo4j or similar).
  • Experience working with distributed data processing (Spark, PySpark, Hadoop).
  • Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP).


Nice to Have

  • Workflow orchestration tools such as Airflow, Prefect, Dagster, Data Factory, or Glue.
  • Snowflake or dimensional modeling (Star Schema).
  • Streaming technologies such as Kafka.
  • Docker or Kubernetes.
  • Azure Data Lake Storage.
  • Data visualization tools such as Power BI, Tableau, or Looker.


Benefits

  • Career development plan and continuous learning.
  • Excellent work environment and flexibility as a CONTRACTOR.
  • 100% remote work.
  • Direct hiring with us.
  • English Class.
  • Benefits platform.
  • Continuous training communities/Certs.
  • AC points (bonus).
  • National Holidays.
  • Company Events (Colombia)
  • Salary: We don't have fixed salary ranges; we tailor the economic offer based on the candidate's salary expectations. In this case, you will let us know your monthly service fee as a CONTRACTOR, and that value will be taken into account when making the offer.


If you’re looking for a place where professional growth goes hand in hand with quality of life, this opportunity is for you!

title: Gerente de vendas regional
description:
Descrição da vaga

Olá, estamos dando suporte a um cliente com forte atuação no segmento de financeiro, para Gerente Regional de vendas focado em relacionamento e expansão de negócios (Vendas B to B to C).

Se você possui excelente habilidade de relacionamento, visão estratégica e paixão por potencializar resultados, essa vaga é para você!

Como será o seu dia a dia:

  • Gerir a carteira de instituições parceiras (IES), construindo relacionamentos de longo prazo e garantindo expansão e performance comercial.
  • Atuar como parceiro estratégico das IES, identificando oportunidades de crescimento e propondo soluções personalizadas que gerem valor ao negócio.
  • Conduzir negociações comerciais complexas, envolvendo reajustes contratuais, metas de captação e acordos de rentabilidade.
  • Acompanhar os principais indicadores da carteira — volume de financiamentos, conversão, inadimplência e NPS institucional.
  • Planejar e coordenar ações conjuntas com áreas internas (Marketing, Produto, Middle Office, Jurídico), assegurando execução e alinhamento operacional.
  • Liderar e orientar times comerciais, garantindo clareza de metas, direcionamento estratégico e desenvolvimento da equipe.
  • Representar a empresa em fóruns, eventos e reuniões estratégicas com mantenedoras e grupos educacionais.

Para isso, buscamos:

  • Profissional com experiência em gestão de contas B2B e liderança de times comerciais.
  • Perfil consultivo, estratégico e orientado a resultados, com habilidade para negociar e gerar parcerias sustentáveis.
  • Forte capacidade analítica para leitura de indicadores e tomada de decisão baseada em dados.
  • Boa articulação com diferentes áreas internas e disposição para atuar de forma colaborativa e prática.
  • Desejável experiencia no segmento de educação superior ou produtos financeiros.

Modelo de trabalho - Presencial -Belém, Porto Velho e São Luis

É oferecido pela empresa:

  • contratação CLT com salário compatível com mercado;
  • Variável (comissão) trimestral por resultado;
  • Horário de trabalho flexível de acordo com área de atuação e política interna.
  • Vale-Refeição ou Vale-Alimentação disponibilizamos o cartão flexível Flash Benefícios, podendo ser utilizado para as funções alimentação e refeição em qualquer estabelecimento com a bandeira MasterCard.
  • Vale Transporte/Estacionamento para os níveis de cargos a partir de gerência, é disponibilizada 1 vaga no estacionamento do escritório.
  • Assistência médica cobertura nacional da Seguros Unimed sem desconto de mensalidades e com coparticipação de 20% para consultas e exames simples.
  • Assistência odontológica Metlife com ampla cobertura nacional, a adesão do plano é opcional.
  • Seguro de Vida Zurich Seguros múltiplo salarial de acordo com política interna.
  • Licenças Ampliadas maternidade e casais homoafetivos possuem 180 dias; paternidade, 20 dias.
  • Auxílio creche de acordo com convenção coletiva, é oferecido para crianças de até 5 anos.
  • PLR para todos os níveis de cargos não comissionados.

title: UX & Data-Driven Usability Designer
description:
UX & Data-Driven Usability Designer


About the Role

We are looking for a UX & Data-Driven Usability Designer to help improve the performance of a large-scale digital commerce platform. This role focuses on identifying friction in critical customer journeys and delivering usability improvements that directly impact conversion.


You will own the Usability workstream, partnering closely with product and analytics teams to analyze user behavior, uncover drop-off points, and design improvements across key transactional flows such as cart, checkout, and payment.


This role is ideal for a designer who combines strong UX thinking with analytical rigor and enjoys working in fast-moving consulting environments where rapid insights and quick wins are highly valued.


What You’ll Do

  • Lead usability analysis across critical customer journeys including product discovery, cart, checkout, and payment.
  • Conduct funnel analysis to identify friction points and conversion drop-offs throughout the purchase process.
  • Partner with product and analytics teams to analyze quantitative data such as conversion rates, abandonment points, and user behavior patterns.
  • Map end-to-end customer journeys to identify quick wins and usability improvements that can drive immediate conversion gains.
  • Design and prototype improvements to transactional flows, focusing on reducing friction and simplifying the purchasing experience.
  • Present insights and design recommendations to stakeholders, clearly tying usability improvements to measurable business impact.
  • Work within a fast-paced consulting team delivering iterative improvements across short delivery cycles.


Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in UX design or product design
  • Strong experience with data-driven design approaches, including funnel analysis and conversion optimization
  • Ability to collaborate with product and analytics teams to interpret quantitative data and translate insights into UX improvements
  • Experience mapping end-to-end user journeys and identifying usability improvements
  • Proven experience redesigning transactional flows such as cart, checkout, or payment experiences
  • Strong problem-solving and research skills
  • Fluency in Portuguese (required working language)
  • Comfort working in fast-paced consulting environments with tight delivery timelines


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience working with A/B testing frameworks and experimentation programs
  • Background designing for marketplace platforms or high-traffic e-commerce products
  • Experience in consulting or agency environments with frequent stakeholder presentations
  • Familiarity with qualitative usability testing methods, including user interviews and moderated testing


This role offers the opportunity to combine UX design and analytics to drive measurable improvements in customer experience and platform performance. If you enjoy solving complex usability challenges and turning data into impactful design decisions, we’d love to hear from you.

title: Senior Murex FO, Remote Brazil
description:
Project description

DXC Luxoft has one of the world's leading Murex practices. We are a top-tier Murex Alliance Partner and a market leader in implementation, integration, upgrade, and migration. We provide end-to-end project services and have delivered over 200 successful Murex projects across all major asset classes and sectors including investment banking, asset management, corporate treasury, and insurance.

Whether you possess a background in finance, technology, or Mathematics, your experience in the capital markets industry would be of high interest to us.

Responsibilities

  • Resolve daily FO issues on both functional, valuation, and pricing
  • Liaise with technical team(s) -
  • when needed -
  • to resolve FO related issues and necessary enhancements
  • Develop FO Business requirements per given stream and according to Project needs as they come along
  • Yield Curve management and validation; curve assignments; new curve creation
  • Products (IRD, CRD, EQD) management and validation
  • Manage day-to-day assigned project tasks to complete various FO deliverables
  • Contribute and assist existing support group(s) in resolving request or issues with P&L, Market Data, and booking issues
  • Analyze, formulate, proposed, develop and/or contribute to overall solutions as per project deliverables
  • Continuous follow-up of new Market regulations/practices globally
  • Perform various levels of testing for assigned deliverables as well as participate in formal release cycles (SIT/UAT)

Skills

Must have

  • Very Strong product knowledge in IRD, CRD, EQD, FX
  • Very strong understanding of IRD, CRD, EQD, FX business
  • Very Strong understanding on P&L concept overall and its components
  • Very Strong understanding and hands-on experience in Market Data, Curve structure, Simulations, and Trade Life Cycle
  • Strong analytical, pricing, and conceptual skills
  • Strong problem solving skills and attention to detail
  • Strong presentation skills
  • Strong relationship building skills both internally and externally
  • Strong experience in supporting FO users and resolving their daily issues
  • Good understanding of Market Risk Management (including VaR, stress-tests, back-testing)

Must:

  • 6+ years experience on Murex with FO functionalities/module
  • experience in financial markets
  • Must have strong personality, logical and analytical skills
  • Be detailed-oriented, a quick learner and self-starter
  • Possess good verbal and written communication skills
  • Must have strong organization skills

Nice to have

  • BS or higher degree in Finance, Mathematics or equivalent
  • Implementations and upgrades of vendor packages like: Calypso, Open Link, Summit, ...etc.
  • Test management
  • Trade life cycle management
  • Market Data management
  • Knowledge in SQL (Oracle and/or Sybase) and Unix commands is a plus
  • Client focus: understands clients' businesses; identifies and understands the needs and objectives of clients, both on an individual and corporate basis; builds strong relationships to aid Excelian's aim of being a trusted partner to the clients.
  • Communication skills: expresses ideas effectively, both verbally and in writing; adjusts language, terminology and non-verbal communication as appropriate.
  • Teamwork: works effectively with others; helps to build strong teams and networks.
  • Personal leadership: realistically identifies own skills, experience, knowledge and other personal attributes; displays confidence and resilience.
  • Planning and organizing: identifies and meets milestones; understands and articulates deliverables; assesses and mitigates risks; sticks to the scope of work and manages any changes.
  • Analytical decision-making: identifies and solves problems using insight and experience to make good decisions; gathers relevant information, identifying important issues and drawing conclusions.

Languages

English: C2 Proficient

Spanish: C2 Proficient

Seniority

Senior

description:
MES Developer

Brazil/Argentina

Contract

Key Accountabilities:

  • This role will provide you with the opportunity to lead key activities to make progress in your career, these responsibilities include some of the following:
  • Participate in requirements gathering to solidify requirements and determine the best technical solution to meet the business needs.
  • Develop and implement new templates, components, and responsive web pages/sites and support client development and security standards while developing.
  • Work in the Manufacturing organization on the implementation of new capabilities.

We are seeking an experienced Developer with strong expertise in GE Plant Applications to design, develop, enhance, and support Manufacturing Execution System (MES) solutions.   • Strong hands-on experience with GE Plant Applications.
  • Proficiency in writing Stored procedure, Functions and other SQL Server related codes. (T-SQL, performance tuning, database design)
  • Experience with .NET technologies (C#, ASP.NET, Web API, Windows Services)

  • Experience with UI design – HTML/Thingworx/ReactJS

  • Knowledge of manufacturing processes and shop-floor systems
  • Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills
  • Ability to work independently and in cross-functional teams
  • Experience designing and optimizing relational databases and stored procedures for optimal performance and/or maintainability.
  • Experience with version control systems (Azure DevOps preferably)
  • Exposure to Agile/Scrum development methodologies.

title: Technical Business Analyst
description:
***Technical Business Analyst – 6 months+ - Brazil (Remote)***



We are currently supporting an international client who is looking for an experienced Technical Business Analyst to join their team working on manufacturing and production IT systems.


This role acts as the key interface between business stakeholders and IT development teams , supporting the deployment, analysis, and improvement of systems such as ERP production

modules, MES, TPS, and SAP .



▶️ Start: ASAP

Duration: 6 months+

Location: Brazil - Remote

Language: English and Portuguese language skills



Key Responsibilities:


• Act as the interface between business users and development teams

• Support the analysis and improvement of manufacturing processes and systems

• Assist with system deployments, go-live, and user support

• Analyse incidents and change requests and assess their impact

• Translate business needs into functional requirements or user stories

• Support Agile delivery and user acceptance testing (UAT)

• Experience as a Technical Business Analyst or Functional Consultant

• Experience with manufacturing or production IT systems

• Knowledge of systems such as ERP (production modules), MES, SCM, WMS, or traceability solutions

• Experience working with business stakeholders and technical teams

• Experience in industrial environments (manufacturing, automotive, pharma, etc.)


Nice to have:


• SQL knowledge

• Experience within industrial sectors such as pharmaceuticals, automotive, aerospace, food production, or manufacturing

description:

  • Collaborate with internal teams, vendors, and partners to drive case resolution.
  • Use empathy, active listening, and emotional intelligence to ensure excellent customer experiences.

  • BA/BS Degree, Computer Science, MIS, or equivalent.
  • 3 years of technical customer support experience.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication in English.
  • Experience or industry knowledge in supply chain software such as warehouse management solutions or order/ inventory management solutions.
  • Experience in database (SQL / Oracle) queries and stored procedures.

description:

Você é uma liderança técnica que transita bem entre a visão de negócio e o código? Busca um desafio onde possa arquitetar soluções robustas e, ao mesmo tempo, mentorar talentos em um ambiente dinâmico? Então essa vaga é para você!


Estamos em busca de um Tech Lead para guiar a evolução tecnológica de produtos financeiros, equilibrando excelência técnica com agilidade de entrega.


O Desafio:

  • Liderança de Arquitetura: Tomada de decisão técnica em stacks ecléticas (Go, Java e Mendix ) e escalabilidade em Cloud OCI .
  • Mão na Massa Estratégica: Atuação consultiva, code reviews críticos e resolução de gargalos de performance.

  • Desenvolvimento de Pessoas: Disseminar boas práticas e elevar a barra de qualidade do time através de mentoria.


O que buscamos:

  • Experiência sólida como Tech Lead ou Arquiteto .
  • Vivência no setor de Serviços Financeiros .
  • Perfil Multi-stack (Go/Java + plataformas Low-code/Mendix).
  • Experiência com OCI (Oracle Cloud Infrastructure) ou outras nuvens.

  • Modelo: PJ (180h/mês).
